#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/provenance_weight_training

CKPT=/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/uniform_1_7b_seed456/final
OUTDIR=/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/uniform_1_7b_seed456/eval_results

# Wait for holdout eval to finish
while kill -0 522907 2>/dev/null; do sleep 10; done
echo "=== Holdout PPL done ==="

# Eval 2: OOD OpenWebText PPL
echo "=== Starting OWT PPL ==="
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -u eval_perplexity.py \
    --checkpoints $CKPT \
    --data_path data/eval_openwebtext.jsonl \
    --max_docs 5000 --max_length 2048 \
    --output_path $OUTDIR/ppl_openwebtext.json
echo "=== OWT PPL done ==="

# Eval 3: OOD Wikipedia PPL
echo "=== Starting Wiki PPL ==="
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -u eval_perplexity.py \
    --checkpoints $CKPT \
    --data_path data/eval_wikipedia.jsonl \
    --max_docs 5000 --max_length 2048 \
    --output_path $OUTDIR/ppl_wikipedia.json
echo "=== Wiki PPL done ==="

# Eval 4: Downstream 5-task
echo "=== Starting Downstream ==="
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=$CKPT,dtype=float16 \
    --tasks arc_easy,arc_challenge,hellaswag,piqa,winogrande \
    --batch_size auto \
    --num_fewshot 0 \
    --output_path $OUTDIR/downstream/
echo "=== Downstream done ==="
echo "=== ALL EVALS COMPLETE ==="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/run_remaining_evals.sh && echo "SCRIPT_READY"
